signups.openText: Raiders can sign up and change their signup again. The event message is updated.
signups.closeText: New signups are no longer possible — signing off still works, and the organisers can keep adding people. The event message shows “Signups closed”.

reopen.title: Undo the cancellation?
reopen.text: The event is open for signups again, and the message loses “CANCELLED”. Anyone who got a cancellation DM will not be told.
reopen.textArchived: The event is open for signups again, and the message loses “CANCELLED”. The channel stays in the archive — bring it back under Channels. Anyone who got a cancellation DM will not be told.

hero.lootClickHint: Click: change it for this raid or add Softres.
hero.signupsClosedSub: Raiders can only sign off now. The organisers can still add people.
hero.eventPostAria: Open the event post in Discord
hero.raidplanAria: Open the raid plan in Raid-Helper

analysis.claTip: Gear, enchants, gems, consumables, drums, potions and shadow resistance. Takes about 25 seconds.
analysis.rpbTip: Avoidable damage, deaths, activity, cooldowns, interrupts and log checks. Takes about a minute.

roster.title: Roster
roster.ownEmpty: Nobody has signed up in EventHelper yet.
roster.benchSub: Bench – you decide in the setup who moves up. {names}
roster.noRolesSub: No raider roles are assigned to this category yet. Click to open Settings › Categories.
roster.signupsUnknownSub: Raid-Helper no longer returns signups for this past raid, and none were saved. Without them everyone would count as “missing”.
roster.membersSub: {error} — the role check needs the “Server Members Intent” enabled in the Discord Developer Portal.
roster.crumbRaidHelperCategory: Raid plan from Raid-Helper · matched against the raider roles of “{category}”
roster.addRaiderSub: Sign someone up or remove them as an organiser — even after the signup deadline.
roster.pingSub: Posts in the event channel and pings exactly the raiders who have not reacted.
roster.roleTipSub: {spread}. Role taken from the spec in the raid plan, not from the signup.
roster.noRaidplan: No raid plan has been created for this event yet.
roster.missingSub: Has a raider role but neither signed up nor signed off
roster.asideAll: everyone who reacted is in the raid plan

loot.title: Loot
loot.counts: Counts as loot in the loot council.
loot.notCounts: Does not count as loot in the loot council, because it adds nothing to the main set.
loot.deleteText: “{item}” for {character} will be deleted from the loot.
loot.clearText: All {count} loot entries of this raid will be deleted. A new import brings them back, manually added items do not.
loot.crumbEmpty: No loot for this raid yet
loot.empty: After the raid, import the Gargul or RCLootcouncil export or add single items by hand.

logs.title: Logs
logs.resetText: This log's analysis is discarded and can be started again afterwards.
logs.unlinkText: The log is unlinked from this raid and shows up again among the unassigned logs.
logs.empty: After the raid, assign a detected log or a Warcraft Logs link to this raid.
logs.unlinkSub: The log is kept, just no longer attached to this raid.

manage.tipSub: Move, close signups, add raiders, signup call, raid sheet, Softres, cancel
manage.historySub: {count} entries — who changed what, and when
manage.deleteSubPast: With confirmation — signups and attendance are lost
manage.deleteSub: Remove the event, signups and message — the channel stays
manage.reopenSub: Signups open again; an archived channel stays in the archive
manage.raiderSub: Sign someone up or remove them
manage.moveSub: New date — the channel is renamed along with it
manage.signupsCloseSub: Only signing off is possible; the organisers can still add people
manage.notifySub: Post the template in the channel and ping roles
manage.sheetSub: Fill a copy of the template and post it
manage.cancelSub: With a reason — DM to everyone signed up
manage.notifyNobody: Nobody signed up — no notice needed.
manage.notifySilent: The {count} signed-up raiders will not be told.
manage.notifyPost: Post in the event channel, {count} signed-up raiders are mentioned.
manage.messageBoth: signup and setup message in the channel
